```{r}
# Install required packages if not already installed
#install.packages("quanteda")

```

```{r}
# Load the necessary libraries
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textstats)
```

```{r}
# Define a sentence
sentenceA <- "DT JJ brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog barks."
```

```{r}
# Convert to corpus
corp <- corpus(sentenceA)
```

```{r}
# Tokenize into words
toks <- tokens(corp, remove_punct = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Create a document-feature matrix (DFM)
dfm_mat <- dfm(toks)
```

```{r}
# Calculate entropy
entropy <- textstat_entropy(dfm_mat)
```

```{r}
# View result
print(entropy)
```
```{r}
?textstat_entropy
```
